name: 常规·锤·T2·武器
prompt:
EXACT OVERRIDING T2 HAMMER SHAPE: one single SOLID BARREL-HEAD HEAVY MALLET. One broad cylindrical or octagonal DRUM spans horizontally at the end of the short grip; two thick flat end caps on ONE uninterrupted central head. The head is connected by a sturdy collar. NO two separated cheek masses, no open crossbar, no holes through the central head. It is an unmistakably SINGLE DRUM mallet silhouette, distinct from basic double blocks and complete open paired blocks. Build the drum in practical iron/brass for standard, matte octagonal rune-stone for omega, large blunt bone plates over rootwood for primal.
Use case: style-transfer / equipment redesign.
Asset type: ONE standalone transparent production game equipment icon, gear-standard-hammer-t2-weapon.
Input images are positive drawing-style references: the simple sword, simple coat and actual game character. Match their soft dark outline and broad matte colour planes. Other comparison references are described at the end. Do not draw characters or UI.
Subject: one complete warhammer with a broad squat hammer head much wider than the handle.
Family identity across all six pieces: broad squat masses, rounded rectangular blocks, round hinge bosses.
Family palette: warm iron grey, amber bronze and brown leather.
Series: STANDARD -- practical forged steel, wood, stitched leather and cloth; restrained brass fittings; functional compact travel equipment, smooth or sloped surfaces, obvious straps and large simple buckles; no giant gems, no decorative spikes. The three series must be visibly different in their outer contour and material construction, even in greyscale.
Stage: T2 DEVELOPED: substantially change the silhouette with TWO large structural layers: visibly wider forked guard/head support, fuller shoulder plates and reinforced collar, taller open helmet brow, larger layered boot cuffs; pendant/ring mounts are clearly larger and double-framed. Keep only one main core. Changes must be obvious at 48px, not engraved lines.
Style: soft warm charcoal/brown outline, chunky rounded object proportions, matte hand-drawn colour blocks, TWO or THREE large shading planes, warm restrained highlights. Keep details broad and legible. Match the new simple chibi items, not the skinny ornate old library.
Composition: diagonal lower-left grip to upper-right functional end, complete and not cropped. Centred on a square transparent canvas, full object visible, longest visible extent roughly 78–82% of canvas, generous equal safety margin. Do not enlarge T3 beyond the common size.
At 32px the equipment part must read immediately; at 48px the family, series and stage must be recognisable by structure. Each icon depicts a coherent physical wearable or weapon, not a pasted symbol.
Constraints: genuinely transparent alpha; ONE isolated object (a pair only for boots). No background, floor, external cast shadow, frames, labels, text, numbers, rarity tags, characters, particles, glowing discs, tiny filigree or dense shiny rendering. Do not generate a sprite sheet or collage. The output is one production PNG.
The overriding object shape described FIRST has priority over all generic main-body and stage descriptions. The endpoints are STYLE references only; copying either outline fails this redesign.
The LAST reference is the completed BASIC T1 version of this exact equipment family and part. Preserve its broad drawing style and family palette, but DO NOT reuse its contour. Make the requested higher stage visibly different through the major outer guard/shoulder/crest/cuff/setting structures; it must not look like T1 with new engraving or extra gems.
Additional comparison: the SECOND-TO-LAST reference is basic T1, and the LAST reference is complete T3. Draw the unmistakeable INTERMEDIATE T2 structure: two substantial layers, with fuller guard/shoulder/crest/cuff/setting than T1 but visibly less extended and simpler than T3. Do not copy either endpoint.
normalization: Alpha-bounds crop; proportional Lanczos resize inside 208×208; centered on a transparent 256×256 canvas.
